value.rationale: Quantitative zero-noise rates are explicitly identified as a future research direction in the motivating paper. Exact constants distinguish probability-profile O(sigma) from induced deterministic partition O(sigma²) for a smooth heterogeneous, truly non-potential game and furnish a globally monotone worked example. These are natural equilibrium observables, not an arbitrary parameter slice or known-table recomputation.
